title: Golden Dandelion Suspicious Stew
description: Wanna make the Golden Dandelion suspicious stew similar to a golden apple?
body:
# Description
This is a lightweight datapack changing what effects is given when a player makes a suspicious stew using the new [Golden Dandelion](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Golden_Dandelion) item.

the pack makes it that the stew will give twice the duration of the saturation effect and give absorption I for 35 seconds when eaten
